name: fund_search
description: Agentic workflow for searching investment funds based on criteria, names, or semantic queries. It handles intent classification, extraction, and orchestrates multiple sub-tools (Semantic, Structured, Position, etc.).

question.description: The user's natural language query about funds.

context_cnpjs.description: Optional list of CNPJs to filter the search (e.g., from previous conversation context).

cnpjs.description: List of discovered CNPJs matching the query.

interpretation_note.description: Explanation of how the query was interpreted.
